{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Remove the 6 QA rows with revenue = 999999.99
print(f"Number of rows before removing QA rows: {len(df)}")
df_clean = df[df['revenue'] != '999999.99']
print(f"Number of rows after removing QA rows: {len(df_clean)}")

# Now filter for NEW customers reached by PAID SEARCH
filtered = df_clean[
    (df_clean['channel'] == 'paid_search') &
    (df_clean['customer_segment'] == 'new')
]

print(f"Number of NEW customers reached by PAID SEARCH: {len(filtered)}")

# Compute conversion rate
converted_count = filtered['converted'].sum()
total_count = len(filtered)
conversion_rate = converted_count / total_count

print(f"Converted: {converted_count}")
print(f"Total: {total_count}")
print(f"Conversion rate: {conversion_rate}")

# Final answer
conversion_rate"}
